label: worktree
definition: The directory one branch is checked out in, under .claude/worktrees/, created by cckit start or cckit effort start and bootstrapped (env files, a dev port, dependencies). One agent works in one worktree; the primary checkout stays parked on the base branch and is never moved by hand.
is_not: The primary checkout: that is the directory the repository was cloned into, shared by every session.
A clone: a worktree shares refs, stash and .cckit/ state with the primary checkout.
A branch: the branch is what is checked out; the worktree is where.
